exposure: sociodemographic characteristics (age, schooling, living with a partner)
outcome: perceived manifestations of obstetric violence (physical, sexual, psychological, institutional)
cohort: The study included 300 pregnant women in their third trimester of pregnancy, assisted in the Family Health Strategy in Montes Claros, Minas Gerais, Brazil.
finding: The study estimated the prevalence of physical (21.7%), sexual (7.0%), psychological (24.3%), and institutional (26.3%) obstetric violence manifestations in prenatal care, finding no association with sociodemographic characteristics.
cross-section timing: 2018-2020, during the third trimester of pregnancy
